newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello aims to balance budget by next poll.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello aims to balance budget by next poll.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday the government would aim to balance the budget by the next election.
"What we are talking about is getting to balance over the life of the parliament, but certainly not in the next financial year (ending June 30)," he said.
Costello earlier announced a revised forecast for the 1996/97 underlying budget deficit of A$8.49 million, compared with the A$5.65 million forecast in the August budget.
The forecast was issued as part of the government's regular mid-year review of budget projections.
The budget year ends on June 30.
The underlying budget deficit excludes items such as asset sales and early repayment of debt by the states.
The government previously said it expected to have an underlying balanced budget by 1998/99 (July-June).
